convert_longformer_qa_checkpoint: convert a Longformer PyTorch Lightning checkpoint to a standard PyTorch model for question answering
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI to convert a Longformer question answering checkpoint from PyTorch Lightning to PyTorch format
load_lightning_model_state: load a PyTorch Lightning model state dict from a checkpoint file for weight extraction
transfer_longformer_weights: transfer Longformer encoder and QA output weights from a Lightning model to a HuggingFace LongformerForQuestionAnswering model
save_converted_model: save a converted Longformer question answering model to a specified output directory
